reuse.why: The change reuses shouldFillCategory, averageToBudgetAmount, extractTagsFromText, spreadsheet access, and the existing undoable action registration.

duplication.why: Category exclusions and amount sign conversion remain shared across existing actions and the new consumer.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget operations remain in actions.ts, with method registration in app.ts and tag parsing in the shared tags module.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested exclusions, new spending action, optional hidden-category inclusion, or associated coverage.

maintainability.why: The shared policy remains straightforward to extend, although average-specific helper names now obscure their broader use and the selection comment omits the hidden-category override.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use shouldFillCategory directly or through getCategoriesForAverage.

disguised_duplication.where: The new action delegates eligibility and sign conversion to existing shared definitions rather than reshaping those decisions locally.

abstraction_drift.where: getCategoriesForAverage gains an includeHiddenCategories forwarding parameter; shouldFillCategory renames its existing hidden option and incorporates shared domain exclusions without consumer-specific exceptions.
